item.title: CXD Lab Attends CHI 2026 in Barcelona
item.description: Phuong Vu Thao, Wooje Kang, Hyunju Kim, and Prof. Bokyung Lee attended CHI 2026 in Barcelona to present research, learn from the HCI community, hold research meetings, and explore the city together.
